rca_of_the_issue: Original prod symptom: PB-HSR Apr 2026 showed 5 different WC values across 5 surfaces (Center Accounts card, Operational Balance card, WC Breakdown table, MIS Dashboard, FO Dashboard). Root cause: (1) the cumulative WC chain was implemented twice — once in calculate_working_capital_standing and once in get_wc_table — and they had diverged on override semantics (commission_target, gst_target, expense_adjustment); (2) the FO Dashboard called /mis/working-capital WITHOUT period params, defaulting to current month, while the rest of the dashboard used the user-selected period. Fix: extracted compute_wc_chain into /app/backend/utils/wc_chain.py as the single source of truth; both callers now route through it. FO Dashboard now passes the same period params to /mis/working-capital as to /mis/overview. Verified via 6-combo audit: all 4 WC surfaces identical; FO visual card matches canonical.
